title: Chapter 16
text: ∫ the strangest thing I was sitting in a chair in the dark the other night not doing anything when the most horrible sounds of torture began in the brush outside my window. it was obviously not a male cat and a female cat but a male and a male and from the sound one appeared to be much larger and attacking with all intent to kill. I sat. then it stopped. then it began again worse this time; the sounds were so terrible that I was unable to move. then it stopped again. I got up from my chair went to bed and slept. I had a dream. this small, very small cat came to me in my dream and it was very sad. it spoke to me, it said: “look what that other cat did to me.” and it turned on my lap and I saw the slashes and indentations. then it jumped off my lap. then that was all. I awakened at 8:45 p.m. put on my clothes and walked outside and looked around. there was nothing there. I walked back inside and dropped two eggs into a pot of water and turned up the burner.
